stabilization.description: Encoder optimization experiment: constraint-space encoder, 2 frames, 20k steps, 3 seeds each. base = constant lr, no clipping; A = grad clip 1.0, 500 warmup steps, cosine decay.

architecture.description: Encoder architecture experiment: constraint-space encoder, 2 frames, 20k steps, stabilized optimization (clip 1.0, warmup 500, cosine), 3 seeds each. A = small Atari-style CNN, B_gap = residual CNN with global average pooling, B_flat = residual CNN with flatten head.

augmentation.description: Augmentation experiment: residual CNN + global pooling, 2 frames, 20k steps, stabilized optimization, 3 seeds. B_gap = no augmentation, C = brightness 0.1, contrast 0.2, noise 0.02, shift 2 px (no flips).
